panel.configureApiKeyDesc: Add an API key in Settings > AI/LLM for Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Mistral, or a local LLM.
panel.installExtensionDesc: AgentCaddy requires the ThreatCaddy browser extension to proxy API requests, or a connected team server.
panel.pausedForReview: {{agent}} is waiting for your review. Other agents keep working.
panel.deployHint: Deploy specialist agents to automate research, enrichment, reporting, and more.
panel.crossCaseOff: Cross-investigation tools are off in investigations that can sync. Deploy this agent in a local-only investigation to compare cases.
panel.escalatedTitle: Tasks this agent escalated to a human after 3 rejections. They need your review.
panel.serverSideModeDesc: Agents continue on the server when your browser is closed
panel.serverAgentsPaused_one: The team server cannot run agents, so {{count}} agent that was set to run there is paused. It does not run in this browser either; deploy it again to run it here.
panel.serverAgentsPaused_other: The team server cannot run agents, so {{count}} agents that were set to run there are paused. They do not run in this browser either; deploy them again to run them here.
panel.noAgentTasks: No agent tasks. Agents create and consume tasks as they work.
panel.policyCeilingNote: These settings limit every agent in this investigation. An agent's own settings can turn an action off, never on.
panel.policyUnsavedNote: No limit is saved for this investigation yet. Deployed agents use their own settings; these apply when no agent is deployed. Changing any setting here makes them the limit for every agent.
panel.enrichDescV2: IOC extraction, and built-in vendor lookups that send the IOC value to that vendor
panel.fetchDescV2: Reference sites only (NVD, CVE, MITRE, CISA, FIRST). Other web pages always ask.
panel.policyLowersNotice: This investigation's auto-approve settings now limit its agents, so some will ask before actions they used to run on their own. The agent settings show who asks before what.
panel.focusAreasPlaceholder: e.g. enrich IOCs, build timeline, look for lateral movement
panel.focusAreasHint: Comma-separated areas the agent should focus on
panel.serverRanActionsTitle_one: Server bot ran {{count}} action while this tab was offline{{topToolSuffix}}. Review the audit thread or dismiss.
panel.serverRanActionsTitle_other: Server bot ran {{count}} actions while this tab was offline{{topToolSuffix}}. Review the audit thread or dismiss.
builtinProfile.leadAnalyst.name: Lead Analyst
builtinProfile.leadAnalyst.description: Orchestrator — delegates work, reviews output, drives investigation forward.
builtinProfile.iocEnricher.name: IOC Enricher
builtinProfile.iocEnricher.description: Enriches IOCs via vendor integrations and OSINT research.
builtinProfile.timelineBuilder.name: Timeline Builder
builtinProfile.timelineBuilder.descripti: Constructs chronological timelines, maps to ATT&CK techniques.
builtinProfile.caseAnalyst.name: Case Analyst
builtinProfile.caseAnalyst.description: General analyst — researches, identifies gaps, creates analysis.
builtinProfile.hypothesisWriter.name: Hypothesis Writer
builtinProfile.hypothesisWriter.descript: Generates falsifiable working theories of the case — claim, evidence (for/against), confidence, how-to-test — as structured notes.
builtinProfile.reporter.name: Reporter
builtinProfile.reporter.description: Synthesizes findings into structured reports and summaries.
builtinProfile.forensicateScanner.name: Forensicate Scanner
builtinProfile.forensicateScanner.descri: Basic check of investigation content for common prompt-injection patterns. The check runs on this device; like every agent, it sends what it reads to your AI model.
builtinProfile.ciso.name: CISO
builtinProfile.ciso.description: Chief Information Security Officer — strategic risk, resource allocation, agent oversight, board-level reporting.
builtinProfile.chiefOfStaff.name: Chief of Staff
builtinProfile.chiefOfStaff.description: Operational coordination — agent oversight, team performance, cross-team alignment.
builtinProfile.threatHunter.name: Threat Hunter
builtinProfile.threatHunter.description: Proactive threat hunting — hypothesis-driven investigation, ATT&CK mapping, behavioral analysis.
builtinProfile.malwareAnalyst.name: Malware Analyst
builtinProfile.malwareAnalyst.descriptio: Malware analysis — sandbox results, indicator extraction, family attribution.
builtinProfile.networkForensics.name: Network Forensics
builtinProfile.networkForensics.descript: Network analysis — flow examination, C2 detection, lateral movement tracing.
builtinProfile.digitalForensics.name: Digital Forensics
builtinProfile.digitalForensics.descript: Disk/memory forensics — artifact analysis, evidence preservation, chain of custody.
builtinProfile.vulnerabilityAnalyst.name: Vulnerability Analyst
builtinProfile.vulnerabilityAnalyst.desc: CVE research — exploit assessment, patch prioritization, attack surface mapping.
builtinProfile.legalCounsel.name: Legal Counsel
builtinProfile.legalCounsel.description: Legal implications — regulatory exposure, evidence admissibility, breach notification requirements.
builtinProfile.complianceOfficer.name: Compliance Officer
builtinProfile.complianceOfficer.descrip: Regulatory compliance — GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOX impact assessment.
builtinProfile.commsLead.name: Communications Lead
builtinProfile.commsLead.description: External communications — stakeholder messaging, media response, customer notification.
builtinProfile.businessContinuity.name: Business Continuity
builtinProfile.businessContinuity.descri: Business impact — recovery priorities, continuity planning, operational workarounds.
builtinProfile.patternHunter.name: Pattern Hunter
builtinProfile.patternHunter.description: Cross-investigation pattern detection — shared IOCs, common infrastructure, campaign correlation. Compares cases only when deployed in a local-only investigation.
dashboard.step1: Open an investigation and go to the AgentCaddy tab
dashboard.step2: Deploy agents — choose from 18 specialist profiles (CISO, IOC Enricher, Legal Counsel, etc.)
dashboard.step3: Click Run Agent or enable auto-mode — agents research, create notes, enrich IOCs, and build timelines
dashboard.step4: Start meetings for agents to discuss findings, or use shift handoffs for continuity
dashboard.supervisorPending_one: {{count}} supervisor proposal waits for your approval
dashboard.supervisorPending_other: {{count}} supervisor proposals wait for your approval
action.lookupNone: Nothing is sent: no enabled lookup applies to {{value}}.
action.lookupUnavailable: Nothing is sent: {{value}} is not available in this investigation.
action.hostIsIoc: This site is an IOC in this investigation. Visiting it can alert the attacker.
profile.noSoulYet: No soul yet — deploy this agent and it will build its identity over time.
profile.executiveRole: Executive — can dismiss, spawn, and manage agents
profile.leadRole: Lead — can delegate tasks and review work
profile.systemPromptPlaceholder: System prompt — instructions for this agent's behavior...
meeting.shiftHandoffTitle: Outgoing agents brief incoming agents, then swap shift states
meeting.meetingAgendaPlaceholder: Meeting agenda — what should the agents discuss?
meeting.participationInfo: {{count}} agents will participate. Each gets {{rounds}} round(s) to contribute. Minutes are saved as a note.
supervisor.couldNotRun: The supervisor agent could not run: {{error}}
supervisor.proposalRationale: CaddyAgent Supervisor proposal. Its reasoning stays in the CaddyAgent Supervisor investigation.
refusal.noApiKey: No API key is configured for {{provider}}.
refusal.configuredProviders: Configured providers: {{providers}}. Set the agent model in AgentCaddy settings.
refusal.noActiveDeployments: No deployed agent is active in this investigation.
refusal.proposerRemoved: This agent is no longer deployed in this investigation, so its proposal cannot run.
refusal.serverProposal: This proposal came from the server and is history only, so nothing ran.
refusal.investigationUnavailable: This investigation was deleted or archived, so nothing ran.
refusal.profileGone: The agent that proposed this no longer exists, so nothing ran.
refusal.toolNotAllowed: This agent can no longer use {{tool}}, so nothing ran.
refusal.targetMoved: What this action changes has moved to another investigation, so nothing ran. Review a new proposal before applying it.
refusal.targetInvestigationUnavailable: What this proposal changes is in an investigation that was deleted or archived, so nothing ran.
refusal.supervisorIocGone: The IOC this proposal updates was deleted, is in the trash or is not in an investigation, so nothing ran.
refusal.supervisorLinkGone: Something this proposal links was deleted, is in the trash or is not a note, task or timeline event in an investigation, so nothing ran.
refusal.supervisorHomeSyncable: This proposal is in an investigation that can sync. The supervisor writes notes and tasks only in its own local-only investigation, so nothing ran.
refusal.otherInvestigationChange: This proposal changes another investigation, which agents cannot do, so nothing ran.
refusal.otherInvestigationRead: This proposal reads another investigation, which agents cannot do from here, so nothing ran.
refusal.notInInvestigation: What this proposal names is not available in this investigation, so nothing ran.
refusal.toolChanged: {{tool}} or its input changed after the agent proposed this, so nothing ran. Review a new proposal before running it.
refusal.readOnlyEntity: This agent may only read what this action would change, so nothing ran.
refusal.taskEscalated: This task was escalated to a human, so agents cannot change it and nothing ran.
